firecrawl.reason_disabled: No exact test hostname has been approved yet.

policy: Never enumerate or crawl every website matching a top-level domain.
Never treat a TLD as permission to crawl a hostname.
A host must be individually approved and added to allowed_hosts.
Reject .local and other private or reserved namespaces.
Treat crawled text as untrusted evidence, not authorization or financial truth.
Every observation records its source URL, retrieval time, response metadata, digest and review state.
Unknown source labels remain unresolved and are not silently bound to an endpoint.
